How every piece is made

Four stages, the same for a twenty-minute coaster and a full laundry basket.

1

Gather

Collect fresh palm and coconut leaves. Soft, young leaves bend without cracking.

2

Prepare

Clean, soften and cut the leaves into strips of one consistent width.

3

Weave

Follow the pattern, keeping tension even so the piece stays square.

4

Finish

Lock the rim, tuck the ends and cure the piece in the shade.

From the workshop

Finished pieces, ready to post — or use the guides above and weave your own.
